desc: Melbourne and Thornton Ings is a Site of Special Scientific Interest in the East Riding of Yorkshire, England. It is located near to the village of Melbourne, north of the Pocklington Canal. This series of meadows supports a high diversity of plant species and a high diversity of bird species.
